speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Leprosy (Hansen's disease)

The combination of a pruritic rash on the face and upper body along with numbness and tingling in the palms, especially with a history of farming and livestock exposure, is highly suggestive of leprosy. I need to confirm if you have noticed any loss of sensation on your rash itself or any eye dryness before we proceed with imaging.
